# Internationalization (i18n) System

## 📋 Contexto

Este documento describe el sistema de internacionalización implementado en Oliva App usando **i18next** y **react-i18next**. El sistema proporciona traducción automática con type-safety completo a través del tipo `Ti18nKeys`.

**Fecha de actualización:** Diciembre 2025
**Librerías:** i18next 25.6.3, react-i18next 15.3.1

---

## 🏗️ Arquitectura del Sistema i18n

```
src/ui/i18n/
├── index.ts                 # Configuración i18next
├── locales/
│   ├── en-EN.ts            # English translations
│   └── es-ES.ts            # Spanish translations (future)
└── hooks/
    └── use-app-translation.ts  # Hook custom para i18n
```

---

## 🎯 Configuración i18next

```typescript
// src/ui/i18n/index.ts
import i18n from 'i18next';
import { initReactI18next } from 'react-i18next';
import { enEN } from './locales/en-EN';

i18n.use(initReactI18next).init({
  resources: {
    en: { translation: enEN },
    // es: { translation: esES },  // Future
  },
  lng: 'en',  // Default language
  fallbackLng: 'en',
  interpolation: {
    escapeValue: false,  // React already escapes
  },
});

export default i18n;
```

**Integración en App:**
```typescript
// src/app/_layout.tsx
import '@/ui/i18n';  // ✅ Import config to initialize i18n

export default function RootLayout() {
  return (
    <I18nextProvider i18n={i18n}>
      {/* ... */}
    </I18nextProvider>

**Uso en Componentes:**
```typescript
export function MyScreen() {
  const { t, changeLanguage, currentLanguage } = useAppTranslation();

  return (
    <View>
      <Text>{t('welcome.message', { name: 'John' })}</Text>
      <Button onPress={() => changeLanguage('es')}>
        Cambiar a Español
      </Button>
    </View>
  );
}
```

### useTranslation (react-i18next)

**Uso directo sin type-safety:**
```typescript
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

export function MyScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return <Text>{t('welcome.message')}</Text>;
}
```

**⚠️ Nota:** Prefiere `useAppTranslation` para type-safety con `Ti18nKeys`.

## 🔄 Integración en Adapters

Los adapters deben traducir automáticamente mensajes al usuario:

```typescript
// src/adapter/toast.notify-port.adapter.ts
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message';
import { t } from 'i18next';
import type { INotifyPort, INotifyParams } from '@/domain/notify/port/notify.port';

export class ToastUINotifyPortAdapter implements INotifyPort {
  private showToast(type: string, params: INotifyParams): void {
    Toast.show({
      type,
      text1: t(params.title),  // ✅ Auto-translate title
      text2: t(params.description),  // ✅ Auto-translate description
      position: 'bottom',
      visibilityTime: 4000,
      autoHide: true,
    });
  }

  public success(params: INotifyParams): void {
    this.showToast('success', params);
  }

  public error(params: INotifyParams): void {
    this.showToast('error', params);
  }
}
```

**Uso desde Hooks:**
```typescript
const { notifyAdapter } = useAdapters();

notifyAdapter.success({
  title: 'success.patient-created',  // i18n key
  description: 'success.patient-created.description',
});

notifyAdapter.error({
  title: 'error.creating-a-patient',
  description: 'error.network',
});
```

## 📝 Agregar Nuevas Traducciones

### Workflow

1. **Agregar clave en locale:**
```typescript
// src/ui/i18n/locales/en-EN.ts
export const enEN = {
  // ... existing keys
  'new-feature.title': 'New Feature',
  'new-feature.description': 'This is a new feature.',
};

export type Ti18nKeys = keyof typeof enEN;  // ✅ Type auto-updates
```

2. **Usar clave en componente:**
```typescript
<TypographyTitle i18nKey="new-feature.title" />
<TypographyParagraph i18nKey="new-feature.description" />
```

3. **Verificar autocomplete:**
   - VSCode/Cursor mostrará `new-feature.title` en sugerencias
   - TypeScript validará que la clave existe

4. **(Futuro) Agregar traducción en otros idiomas:**
```typescript
// src/ui/i18n/locales/es-ES.ts
export const esES = {
  'new-feature.title': 'Nueva Funcionalidad',
  'new-feature.description': 'Esta es una nueva funcionalidad.',
};
```

## 🧪 Testing con i18n

### Mock i18next en Tests

```typescript
// tests/setup.ts
jest.mock('react-i18next', () => ({
  useTranslation: () => ({
    t: (key: string) => key,  // Return key as-is
    i18n: {
      changeLanguage: jest.fn(),
      language: 'en',
    },
  }),
  Trans: ({ i18nKey }: { i18nKey: string }) => i18nKey,
}));
```

### Test Translation Keys

```typescript
// tests/unit-test/components/parent-info-step.test.tsx
import { render } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { ParentInfoStep } from '@/ui/components/organisms/parent-info-step.organism';

describe('ParentInfoStep', () => {
  it('should render title with correct i18n key', () => {
    const { getByText } = render(<ParentInfoStep />);

    // Since t() mock returns key, check for key presence
    expect(getByText('parent-setup.parent-info.title')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

## 🌍 Soporte Multi-Idioma (Futuro)

### Configuración con Múltiples Idiomas

```typescript
// src/ui/i18n/index.ts
import i18n from 'i18next';
import { initReactI18next } from 'react-i18next';
import { enEN } from './locales/en-EN';
import { esES } from './locales/es-ES';

i18n.use(initReactI18next).init({
  resources: {
    en: { translation: enEN },
    es: { translation: esES },  // ✅ Spanish support
  },
  lng: 'en',  // Default
  fallbackLng: 'en',
  interpolation: { escapeValue: false },
});

export default i18n;
```

### Selector de Idioma (UI)

```typescript
export function LanguageSelectorScreen() {
  const { changeLanguage, currentLanguage } = useAppTranslation();

  return (
    <View>
      <TypographyTitle i18nKey="settings.language.title" />

      <Pressable onPress={() => changeLanguage('en')}>
        <Text>English {currentLanguage === 'en' && '✓'}</Text>
      </Pressable>

      <Pressable onPress={() => changeLanguage('es')}>
        <Text>Español {currentLanguage === 'es' && '✓'}</Text>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}
```

### Ejemplo 1: Parent Setup Form

// src/ui/components/organisms/parent-info-step.organism.tsx
export function ParentInfoStep() {
  return (
    <View>
      <TypographyTitle i18nKey="parent-setup.parent-info.title" />
      <TypographyParagraph
        variant="light"
        i18nKey="parent-setup.parent-info.description"
      />

      <TextFieldAtom
        labelKey="parent-setup.parent-info.name-label"
        placeholder={t('parent-setup.parent-info.name-placeholder')}
        value={name}
        onChangeText={setName}
      />
    </View>
  );
}
```

**Keys en locale:**
```typescript
'parent-setup.parent-info.title': 'About you',
'parent-setup.parent-info.description': 'Basic caregiver information.',
'parent-setup.parent-info.name-label': 'Name:',
'parent-setup.parent-info.name-placeholder': 'Your name',
```

### Ejemplo 2: Toast Notifications

```typescript
// src/hooks/use-parent-setup-form.hook.ts
export function useParentSetupForm() {
  const { notifyAdapter } = useAdapters();

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    try {
      await patientAdapter.create({ name, birthDate });

      notifyAdapter.success({
        title: 'success.patient-created',  // ✅ i18n key
        description: 'success.patient-created.description',
      });
    } catch (error) {
      notifyAdapter.error({
        title: 'error.creating-a-patient',  // ✅ i18n key
        description: 'error.network',
      });
    }
  };
}
```

**Keys en locale:**
```typescript
'success.patient-created': 'Patient created successfully',
'success.patient-created.description': 'You can now add caregivers.',
'error.creating-a-patient': 'Error creating patient',
'error.network': 'Network error. Check your connection.',
```

### Ejemplo 3: Button Atom con i18n

```typescript
// atoms/button.atom.tsx
interface ButtonAtomProps extends Omit<ButtonProps, 'children'> {
  titleKey: Ti18nKeys;  // ✅ Type-safe i18n key
}

export const ButtonAtom = ({ titleKey, ...props }: ButtonAtomProps) => {
  return (
    <Button className="rounded-lg" {...props}>
      <TypographyParagraph className="text-white" i18nKey={titleKey} />
    </Button>
  );
};
```

**Uso:**
```typescript
<ButtonAtom
  titleKey="common.next"
  variant="primary"
  onPress={goToNextStep}
/>
```

## ✅ Checklist de Implementación

- [ ] i18next configurado en `_layout.tsx`
- [ ] Locale principal (`en-EN.ts`) con todas las claves
- [ ] Tipo `Ti18nKeys` exportado desde locale
- [ ] `TextTranslation` component creado
- [ ] Typography atoms usan `i18nKey` prop
- [ ] Adapters traducen automáticamente (`t(key)`)
- [ ] Hook `useAppTranslation` disponible para type-safety
- [ ] Tests mockean `react-i18next`
- [ ] No hay strings hardcoded en UI (solo i18n keys)

---

## 🚫 Anti-Patrones a Evitar

| Anti-Patrón | Problema | Solución |
|-------------|----------|----------|
| Hardcodear strings en componentes | Sin i18n, no traducible | Usar `i18nKey` con `Ti18nKeys` |
| `t('invalid-key')` sin type-check | Runtime error si clave no existe | Usar `Ti18nKeys` type |
| Crear claves anidadas en JS | Difícil de refactorizar | Usar flat dictionary con dot notation |
| Traducir en componente final | Duplicación, error-prone | Traducir en adapters/hooks |
| Omitir interpolación | Strings estáticos sin variables | Usar `values` en `t(key, values)` |
| `children` en Typography atoms | Bypassa i18n | Usar `i18nKey` prop |
